svg.title: The Libero design hierarchy of fabric design 102. aegis_pqc2_fic0 is the port wrapper; inside it aegis_pqc2 holds aegis_ntt (unchanged, with the modular multiplier, twiddle ROM and RAM) and aegis_sponge, with the Keccak round function and the RAM that holds the 8 slots.
svg.desc: The Libero design hierarchy of fabric design 102. aegis_pqc2_fic0 is the port wrapper; inside it aegis_pqc2 holds aegis_ntt (unchanged, with the modular multiplier, twiddle ROM and RAM) and aegis_sponge, with the Keccak round function and the RAM that holds the 8 slots.

g.text: Port wrapper: 32-bit addresses and the interconnect's signal widths.
Registers, PREADY wait, the NTT and the sponge.
State in the fabric, 8 slots in block RAM, the DMA engine.
